assessment.details: Automated checks, keyboard-only testing and screen reader testing with NVDA + Firefox and VoiceOver + Safari on the 12 most used page templates.

compatible_with: recent versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari and Edge
NVDA and JAWS on Windows, VoiceOver on macOS and iOS, TalkBack on Android

known_issues.title: Product image carousel cannot be paused
known_issues.impact: Moving content distracts some users and screen readers re-announce slides.
known_issues.workaround: All product images are also listed on the product details tab.

exemptions.title: Archived PDF newsletters published before 2024
exemptions.reason: Archived content not needed for current services; accessible versions on request.
